Full manuscript in two months.
That was the goal.
I was on vacation in Mexico, no less, when I checked my email and saw the opportunity.
It was mid-June and the conference was happening near the city of Oaxaca.
The invitation was from a publisher looking for innovative short stories, exactly what I wanted to work on while relaxing on the beach and enjoying the sun.
I felt my ego swelling as I imagined myself being among literary greats, sharing my work with professionals who truly understood the craft.
I accepted the invitation without hesitation, feeling confident that my writing skills would shine through.
After all, I had been working diligently, honing my craft for years.
But as the deadline approached, my initial enthusiasm began to wane, replaced by a sense of dread and anxiety.
What started as a dream quickly turned into a nightmare as the weight of the expectation settled on my shoulders.
Day after day, I sat at my laptop, staring blankly at the blinking cursor, feeling increasingly frustrated.
Every word seemed to be an uphill battle, each sentence a step backward.
My ego—always so inflated—became my worst enemy.
It whispered doubts, telling me that perhaps I wasn’t cut out for this kind of challenge, that my talent was overrated.
Instead of encouraging me, it sabotaged any progress I managed to make.
As the days passed, my frustration grew.
I found myself comparing my unfinished manuscript to others’ finished works, feeling inadequate and jealous.
The pressure to produce quality work paralyzed my creativity, turning what should have been a joyous and fulfilling experience into one of self-doubt and frustration.
Finally, as the deadline loomed, I hit rock bottom.
The guilt and fear of failure were overwhelming.
Instead of submitting my best work or even an honest attempt, I submitted the first draft that came to mind—a rushed, poorly edited piece that barely captured the essence of what I hoped to achieve.
How Prepared Are You for the Revolution?
Once upon a time, not that long ago in the restaurant, food and hospitality industry, the formula for success was pretty simple to grasp.
Following the formula was widely accepted as the guaranteed path to making money.
It involved a combination of high-quality food, exceptional service, an inviting ambiance, and strategic marketing.
But today, the hospitality industry is experiencing a seismic shift.
Disruptive technologies, changing consumer behaviors, and global economic shifts have forced traditional players to reevaluate their strategies.
Are you ready for this revolution?
Let's explore what’s shaking up the industry.
First, the advent of digital technologies is transforming every aspect of hospitality.
From online reservation systems to personalized guest experiences, technology is not just a tool; it has become an integral part of the guest journey.

Companies like Booking.com, Airbnb, and TripAdvisor have disrupted the travel and lodging sectors by providing more choices and direct booking options, forcing hotels and resorts to rethink their business models and digital presence.
Second, sustainability and environmental concerns are no longer optional but necessary considerations.
Consumers, particularly millennials and Generation Z, prioritize eco-friendly practices and responsible tourism.
This shift towards sustainability has spurred innovations such as smart energy management systems, waste reduction initiatives, and locally sourced, organic ingredients in restaurants.
Hotels and restaurants that fail to embrace these changes risk alienating eco-conscious travelers.
Third, globalization and cultural shifts mean that the hospitality industry now serves a diverse clientele with varying expectations.
Cultural sensitivity and inclusivity are becoming critical factors.
This means offering multilingual services, accommodating dietary restrictions, and ensuring representation through staff and menu offerings.
Brands that fail to adapt risk losing market share to those who cater to this new reality.
Fourth, the rise of social media and influencer culture has transformed marketing.
Gone are the days when advertising alone could drive traffic and sales.
Now, influencers and user-generated content play a significant role.
Authentic experiences and genuine connections are the new currency of the hospitality industry.
Gather Input from Organizations and Partners Across Vermont, to Determine What These Groups Will Be in Vermont
Aldo Das Nov 25, 2020 · 3 min read
As the world awaits the results of COVID-19 vaccine clinical trials, we find ourselves at a pivotal moment.
The ongoing pandemic has underscored the importance of community resilience and collaboration in the face of unprecedented challenges.
In Vermont, where communities have consistently shown strength and unity, it is imperative that we continue to engage with organizations and partners across the state to shape our collective future.
The process of gathering input from diverse stakeholders is crucial for ensuring that policies and initiatives are informed by real-world needs and are sustainable over time.

By actively engaging with a wide array of voices, including small businesses, schools, healthcare providers, non-profits, and local governments, we can better understand how to allocate resources and address the specific needs of our communities.
One of the primary goals of this inclusive dialogue should be to define what it means to thrive in Vermont post-pandemic.
This involves not only recovering from the economic and social impacts of the crisis but also envisioning a Vermont that is even more resilient, equitable, and vibrant than before.
For instance, small businesses play a critical role in the Vermont economy.

Listening to their concerns and suggestions could lead to tailored support mechanisms, such as targeted grants, streamlined regulatory processes, or innovative digital platforms that enhance customer engagement.
Similarly, educational institutions can provide valuable insights into adapting to remote learning models while ensuring student well-being and academic success.
Healthcare providers, meanwhile, offer firsthand knowledge on public health strategies and patient care needs.
Their perspectives can inform vaccination rollouts, mental health support services, and community wellness initiatives.
Engaging with local governments helps align state-level policies with regional priorities, ensuring that resources are allocated efficiently and effectively.
Non-profit organizations often fill critical gaps in service delivery, particularly in areas like housing, food security, and community development.
How to Change Your Programming to Achieve the Results You Desire
If negative thoughts turn into beliefs that determine your behavior, then the opposite holds true.
Positive thoughts and beliefs can lead to positive action.
This means we can reprogram our minds to achieve anything we set our minds to.
The power to change lies within us, and it starts with two simple yet powerful techniques that anyone can practice.
The first step is to identify and challenge negative thought patterns.
Our subconscious mind often operates on autopilot, and it can be flooded with negative self-talk that we may not even be aware of.
When you catch yourself thinking critically or negatively about yourself or situations, pause for a moment.
Ask yourself, “Is this thought productive?” or “Is there a more positive way to view this situation?” Replacing these negative thoughts with affirmations can help shift your mindset.

For instance, if you find yourself thinking, “I’m not good enough,” try replacing it with, “I am capable and worthy.” Over time, these affirmations can become part of your core belief system, leading to more positive actions and outcomes.
The second step is to immerse yourself in environments and activities that support your goals.
This might seem like common sense, but it’s incredibly effective when combined with positive thinking.
Surrounding yourself with positivity—whether it’s through reading inspirational books, attending workshops, or engaging in supportive communities—can significantly influence your mindset.
Choose environments where you feel empowered and inspired.
For example, if you want to become a better public speaker, seek out opportunities to practice in front of friends or attend local speaking events.
By immersing yourself in positive experiences and surrounded by supportive influences, you create an environment conducive to success.
These two methods are not only simple but also profound in their impact.
They require consistent effort and patience, much like planting seeds and tending to a garden.
As you cultivate new habits and beliefs, you’ll begin to see changes in your behavior and achievements.
### Why Everyone Should Consider Buying a Sex Doll
There’s nothing weird about owning a sex doll.
Most of us would, if they were cheaper.
A sex doll costs about as much as a car.
I’m talking high-end models, not the inflatable ones.
Those run around a hundred dollars; these cost thousands.
Yet, despite their steep price, sex dolls offer numerous benefits that make them worth every penny.
Firstly, let’s address the misconception that sex dolls are only for those in need.
In reality, they are a valuable tool for anyone seeking companionship, emotional support, or physical satisfaction.

For individuals who may find it difficult to form romantic relationships or maintain sexual intimacy due to various reasons—such as distance, time constraints, or personal preferences—sex dolls can provide a non-judgmental, consistent partner.
This is not about cheating or replacing a human partner, but rather about augmenting one's life and well-being in a way that traditional dating or relationships might not always allow.
Consider the stress and strain of real-life interactions.
Human relationships are complex, requiring constant effort to maintain, manage, and repair.
They can be emotionally draining, and sometimes, even hurtful.
With a sex doll, you have complete control over the relationship.
No arguments, no misunderstandings, just mutual respect and understanding.
The ability to set boundaries and control scenarios can be incredibly liberating and comforting for many.
Moreover, sex dolls can enhance self-esteem and body confidence.
Often, people who struggle with body image issues or past traumas find comfort and acceptance in the physical representation of themselves in a sex doll.
These models are meticulously crafted to resemble the owner, ensuring that every interaction feels authentic and affirming.
The doll can serve as a tangible reminder of one’s worth and beauty, contributing positively to mental health and overall happiness.
From a broader societal perspective, sex dolls can also help reduce the demand for exploitative or unethical forms of entertainment.

Learning how to love me through creative writing has proven to be a powerful tool in my life.
My thoughts become more apparent, and it leads me to feel confident on my own.
When I am my own advocate, I can better navigate the complexities of personal growth and relationships.
Writing is not just about capturing moments or emotions; it is about becoming more aware of myself and developing a stronger sense of self.
In the midst of the towering sandstone cliffs and winding rivers of Zion, I often find myself journaling.
The act of putting pen to paper helps me sort through my feelings, identify my strengths, and confront my weaknesses.
It's like standing at the base of a grand canyon and looking up—everything seems smaller, but also more clearly defined.
Through this introspection, I learn to appreciate my unique voice and perspective.
Being my own advocate means believing in myself and my capabilities.
It requires courage to stand up for what I believe in and to speak out when I am wronged.
In my daily life, this might mean setting boundaries with friends and family, advocating for myself at work, or simply making time for activities that bring joy and fulfillment.
Often, we allow external pressures to dictate our happiness and self-worth.
However, through creative writing, I have learned to focus on internal validation and self-love.
Creative writing also serves as a form of therapy.
When I pour my thoughts onto the page, I am able to process experiences that might otherwise overwhelm me.
This therapeutic benefit extends beyond personal challenges; it can also help improve interpersonal relationships.
By expressing my needs and boundaries clearly, I foster healthier connections and avoid misunderstandings.
When I am assertive without being aggressive, I find that others are more willing to listen and respect my needs.
Moreover, being my own advocate through writing encourages a growth mindset.
Every piece I compose is an opportunity to learn and evolve.
Dear Prospect,
How do you approach the salesman that sells a particular product you find lovely?
— is it that you buy because of humour or the way he introduces the product to you when he displays part of his ethos as a salesman?
Just know, these qualities can sometimes make all the difference.
In a world saturated with choices and competition, a good salesman isn’t just someone who sells products; he’s a beacon of inspiration and reassurance.
Let's delve into why these personal touches often play a pivotal role in our purchasing decisions.
Firstly, humor is a powerful tool in breaking down barriers and creating a connection.
A salesman who can laugh at the right moment and share a relatable anecdote can transform the interaction from a mundane transaction into a memorable experience.
This connection fosters trust and makes the sales process more enjoyable, which in turn can lead to a more positive perception of the product and the seller.
Secondly, when a salesman genuinely embodies the ethos of his brand or product, it creates an authentic atmosphere.
His passion for what he sells can be contagious.
If he talks about his product with enthusiasm and conviction, it's hard not to feel a little bit of that excitement yourself.
This authenticity builds credibility, making the product seem more appealing and reliable.
Moreover, the introduction of the product is where a skilled salesman truly shines.
He doesn't just describe features; he paints a picture of how the product will fit into your life, solve a problem, or enhance your experience.
This narrative approach helps potential buyers envision themselves using the product, which can be incredibly persuasive.
But it goes beyond the sales pitch itself.
The overall experience matters.
When a salesman greets you with warmth, listens actively to your needs, and shows genuine interest, it elevates the whole interaction.
This level of service and care can make even a routine purchase feel special and significant.
Last week’s report about the state of women leadership in Chicago tech was a powerful reminder of where our successes are and where we can continue to improve.
The data creates actionable opportunity for everyone — from individual contributors, to executives, to investors — to contribute to a more inclusive ecosystem.
While these statistics offer a crucial snapshot of progress and areas for growth, they also highlight a significant narrative: when women lead, communities thrive.
This principle is particularly resonant when we look at Detroit, a city that has been revitalizing its economy and fostering innovation through the entrepreneurial spirit of trailblazing women.
Detroit, known for its industrial heritage and recent resurgence, is now witnessing an entrepreneurial renaissance driven by dynamic women leaders.
These 10 women are not just making waves; they are propelling the city forward with a vision that embraces diversity, innovation, and community.
Their stories are testament to the transformative power of female leadership in reshaping the local economy and society.
At the helm of this movement is Maria Estefania, CEO of Aerie Beauty, who is redefining beauty standards by championing inclusivity and body positivity.
Her approach is more than just a business strategy; it’s a cultural shift, reflecting a broader societal acceptance of diverse beauty.
Similarly, Nia Jones, CEO of Nia Solutions, is leveraging technology to drive social change, focusing on education and workforce development.
Through her initiatives, she is empowering Detroit’s youth and addressing critical gaps in access to quality education and job training.
Jada Williams, founder of the Detroit-based tech firm, Detroit AI, is another shining example.
She is not only creating jobs but also fostering a culture of innovation within the tech sector.
Her commitment to mentorship and community engagement is nurturing a new generation of entrepreneurs and technologists.
Her work is crucial in building a sustainable ecosystem where ideas can flourish and impact the lives of countless individuals.
1. Let the drama happen around you, not with you
It’s a bit embarrassing for me that Charice and Johann have witnessed my continuous failures in relationships.
They have listened to my rants and given me compassionate advice in the six years we've been friends, but I’ve always been too caught up in my own world of drama to really learn from them.
I’ve seen firsthand how their healthy relationship dynamics differ from mine—and it has left me reflecting on what needs to change if I want to manifest a long-term love life immediately.
2. Communication is Key to a Harmonious Partnership
One of the most crucial lessons I've learned from observing my friends' relationship dynamics is the importance of open and honest communication.
In my past relationships, I’ve often found myself bottling up emotions or letting small issues fester until they become insurmountable problems.
This has led to misunderstandings and hurt feelings on both sides, often escalating into arguments or even breakups.
I’ve come to realize that communication isn’t just about talking; it’s about listening as well.
Active listening means truly understanding where your partner is coming from, validating their feelings, and working together to find solutions.
This involves setting aside time for meaningful conversations without distractions, expressing your thoughts and feelings honestly, and being willing to compromise when needed.
3. Mutual Growth and Support
In any long-term relationship, mutual growth and support are essential.
It’s important to recognize that growth is a lifelong process and that your partner should be someone who supports you in your goals and aspirations, while you do the same for them.
This doesn’t mean abandoning your individuality; rather, it means fostering a partnership where each person feels valued and supported.
Mutual growth also involves being there for your partner during tough times and celebrating their successes.
It’s about building a foundation of trust and respect that allows you to navigate challenges together.
This in simple words means that the traits of childhood continue in manhood.
In other words, if we want to have better men, we must first have better children.
If we pay no attention to the child, he grows into a worthless youth and eventually becomes a man of questionable character.
This timeless aphorism, "The child is the father of man," encapsulates the idea that our formative years shape the adults we become.

Educators, parents, and policymakers often emphasize the importance of a child's upbringing, yet the significance of early development is sometimes overlooked or sidelined by immediate societal pressures.
Childhood is a period of immense plasticity, during which the human brain is more receptive to external influences than at any other time.
It is during this crucial stage that habits, values, and character are formed, setting the foundation for future behavior.
Consider, for instance, the impact of nurturing versus neglecting a child’s emotional well-being.
A child who feels loved and supported is more likely to grow into a compassionate and empathetic adult.
Conversely, a child who experiences neglect or abuse may develop trust issues, aggression, or a myriad of mental health challenges that persist throughout their life.
This cycle of trauma can perpetuate not only personal suffering but also societal ills such as crime, violence, and overall decreased quality of life.
Moreover, the role of education plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of humanity.

Quality education, which goes beyond mere academic instruction to include emotional intelligence, critical thinking, and social skills, equips children with the tools necessary to navigate life successfully.
Education is not just about preparing students for college or career; it is about fostering responsible and engaged citizens who contribute positively to society.
However, access to quality education remains a significant disparity worldwide.
In many parts of the world, educational resources are scarce, leading to undereducated and underprepared individuals who may struggle to find meaningful employment or stable lives.
